lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as multiple columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in an organized grid pattern along the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming discernible grid-like anchor nodes on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A discernible notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the right pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple dark, elongated silhouettes (remoras) attached to the ventral surface, clustered primarily near the midline and pelvic fins.
